title: The Life and Legacy of Nelson Mandela

sentences.text: Nelson Mandela is a famous man.
He was born in South Africa.
He grew up in a small village.
There was a system called apartheid.
He was in jail for 27 years.
People all over the world knew about him.
They wanted him to be free.
He was the first black president of South Africa.
